name: burrete
description: Operate Burrete as an agent-accessible molecular workspace for structures, Mol* scenes, molecule collections, trajectories, and workflow result artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Burrete lets an assistant open molecular structures in Browser preview or the real desktop app, observe scene state as structured JSON, run allowlisted Mol* actions, render adjacent notes/tables/charts/reports, and hand off externally prepared molecular workflow artifacts for review. It keeps molecular commands typed and auditable while using Browser and Computer surfaces for visual verification.
defaultPrompt: Open this structure in Burrete and describe the active molecular scene
Hide waters, focus the ligand, and render a right-side notes panel
Review this SDF/property table and show the selected molecule in Burrete
